Vendored third-party files (committed; the console never loads scripts from a CDN).
The sumo build of libsodium.js is used because it exports crypto_hash_sha256 (secret fingerprint),
which the standard build omits; WebCrypto digest is not used because it needs a secure context.

libsodium-sumo.js
  npm package   libsodium-sumo@0.8.4 (file dist/modules-sumo/libsodium-sumo.js)
  npm integrity sha512-TMtHShQfVVsaxDygyapvUC3o7YsPgXa/hRWeIgzyFz6w5k/1hirGptCxp1U7XwW3rCskaTTYKgV10v86UiGgNw==
  sha256        a3d0b7eb2c24ba6b5401d88717e65bc6a92786d211bc8b91ed746d24226180f3
  license       ISC (LICENSE-libsodium.js.txt)

libsodium-wrappers-sumo.js
  npm package   libsodium-wrappers-sumo@0.8.4 (file dist/modules-sumo/libsodium-wrappers.js)
  npm integrity sha512-ql7hcgulKZ3ekfa2DGAogcCKsWU0diA/0nArz1CFzh93WQdb46/Kj18ka/Hifq6uA3Ush34Pc6vU/6HXeRwUkg==
  sha256        4e2c5442899321d7d9aea69bef71a3c24a6eab5911b74a5c1ad8bc8c733b0a15
  license       ISC (LICENSE-libsodium.js.txt)

Update procedure: npm pack both packages at the same version, copy the two files above, update the
hashes here and in tests/unit/console/test_sealbox.py, and run the sealbox tests (they seal in node with
these exact files and open the result with PyNaCl).
